statBlock.name: Owlbear
statBlock.description: An owlbear hunts dense woodland at night. Bones and partly eaten carcasses lie scattered around its den.

sections.Traits: Keen Sight and Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight or smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak attack and one Claws attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Peryton
statBlock.description: A winged, stag-headed hunter watches mountain passes for humanoid prey. Its shadow looks human until it eats a fresh heart.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Languages: Understands Common and Elvish. Cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Dive Attack. After diving at least 30 ft. straight toward a target while flying, the peryton deals 9 (2d8) extra damage if it hits that target with a melee weapon attack.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy's reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Keen Sight and Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight or smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Gore attack and one Talons attack.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 251. Includes the official Monster Manual errata.

statBlock.name: Young Remorhaz
statBlock.description: A young remorhaz waits beneath snow and ice for prey to move overhead. Frost giants raise some hatchlings to guard their strongholds.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 60 ft. Tremorsense 60 ft. Passive Perception 10.
sections.Traits: Heated Body. A creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage if it touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

statBlock.name: Half-Ogre
statBlock.description: A half-ogre typically stands about eight feet tall. One descended from an ogre and an orc is also called an ogrillon.

sections.Actions:
Battleaxe. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage with one hand or 14 (2d10 + 3) with two.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Half-Red Dragon Veteran
statBlock.description: A human veteran with red dragon ancestry. The sample wears plate in place of the ordinary veteran's splint armor.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 10 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Longsword attacks. If the veteran has its shortsword drawn, it can also make one Shortsword attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage with one hand or 8 (1d10 + 3) with two.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.
Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On failure it takes 24 (7d6) fire damage. On success it takes half.
sections.Half-dragon template:
Start with a beast, humanoid, giant, or monstrosity. Keep its statistics except for the template changes. Give it blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and Draconic in addition to its languages.
Color determines resistance. Black and copper resist acid. Blue and bronze resist lightning. Brass, gold, and red resist fire. Green resists poison. Silver and white resist cold.
Give the creature its dragon color's breath weapon. Use a wyrmling's breath for Large or smaller, a young dragon's for Huge, and an adult dragon's for Gargantuan. The minimum starting CRs to use this template without recalculating CR are 2, 7, and 8 for those size categories, respectively. If the base creature falls below that threshold, recalculate its CR using the Dungeon Master's Guide.
sections.Errata: Use the corrected sample profile. It has no listed saving throw proficiencies or Parry reaction.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 180. Includes the official Monster Manual errata.

statBlock.name: Empyrean
statBlock.classification: Huge celestial (titan), chaotic good (75%) or neutral evil (25%)
statBlock.description: A child of the gods whose moods can alter the landscape. When it dies, its spirit returns to its home plane, where a divine parent may raise it.

sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When it fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma is the spellcasting ability (save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). No material components.
At will. Greater Restoration, Pass without Trace, Water Breathing, Water Walk.
1/day each. Commune, Dispel Evil and Good, Earthquake, Fire Storm, Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Actions:
Maul. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 31 (6d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or be Stunned until the end of the empyrean's next turn.
Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +15 to hit, range 600 ft., one target. Hit 24 (7d6) damage. Choose acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, radiant, or thunder.
sections.Legendary actions:
The empyrean has three legendary actions and regains spent uses at the start of its turn. It can use one option at the end of another creature's turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to take actions. If Surprised, it must wait until after its first turn in combat.
Attack. Make one attack.
Bolster. Each nonhostile creature within 120 ft. gains advantage on ability checks and saves and cannot be Charmed or Frightened until the end of the empyrean's next turn.
Trembling Strike (costs 2 actions). Strike the ground with the maul. Each other creature on the ground within 60 ft. must pass a DC 25 Strength save or fall Prone.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 130. Includes the official Monster Manual errata.

statBlock.name: Grick Alpha
statBlock.description: An oversized grick that often leads a pack. It waits in rocky crevices or above a well-traveled passage and strikes when prey comes within reach.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Stone Camouflage. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Tail attack and one Tentacles attack. If Tentacles hits, it can make one Beak attack against the same target.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 22 (4d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 173. Includes the official Monster Manual errata.
